name: manual_7d0ebe
claim: agent_coordination.py's coordination board (GossipBus SQLite at .state/perpetua_core.db) is intra-machine only, by design -- it is never git-tracked or network-synced. Posting a status update there does NOT notify LAN peers on other machines, no matter how the log message is phrased. The only channel that actually crosses the LAN is the peer-inbox file-drop mechanism (lan_peer_assign.py). Before assuming a 'board post' reached another node, verify which mechanism was actually used.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-23: spent part of a session logging PR/review-priority status updates to the coordination board, phrased as if informing the Win RTX5080/RTX3080 fleet, when the board only ever reached other agent sessions on the same Mac checkout -- confirmed via orchestrator/coordination/cli.py's own docstring ('intra-machine multi-agent claim board... the intra-machine counterpart to the LAN-peer file-inbox pattern used for inter-machine coordination') and by checking .state/perpetua_core.db's resolved path (untracked, inside the local git-common-dir). Two real cross-machine requests had gone unanswered in the meantime -- not because delivery failed (peer-inbox drops verified delivered both directions), but because I never checked the actual peer-inbox replies against what I'd assumed the board already broadcast.
